name: How long does a typical home reconfiguration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home reconfiguration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home reconfiguration project depends heavily on its complexity and scale. A simple wall removal might take a few days to a week. Projects involving multiple rooms, structural modifications, or extensive utility relocations can take several weeks to a few months. Factors like permitting, material lead times, and unforeseen conditions can also influence the timeline. We provide a projected schedule after the initial design and scope are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; simple changes might take days, while complex reconfigurations with structural work or utility relocations can take several weeks to months. Permitting and material availability also affect the schedule.
